items.title: Google Ads Language Targeting Update Coming In September
items.summary: Google Ads will roll out a change to language targeting that will remove the ability to manually adjust the language setting. This change is happening next month, in September 2026. Google said its ad systems already match languages automatically and enhanced AI prioritization will automatically select the most relevant ad language when there are eligible ads in multiple languages, Google told me.

items.title: Google Merchant Center For Agencies Can Link Up To 1,000 Accounts
items.summary: Google updated a help document within the Google Merchant Center help area to document that Google Merchant Center for Agencies can now link to up to 1,000 Merchant Center accounts. Previously, that number was not there, and now we know - up to 1,000 accounts can be linked to a single agency account.

items.title: Googlebot Say They Are Coming From California But Might Not
items.summary: As we know, Google has often declared that its crawlers, Googlebot, etc, come from Mountain View, California.  But the truth is, that is where they self-declare the bots are coming from. Google has data centers all over the world, and even though Google may be declaring the crawler is coming from a specific location, it might be coming from a different location.

items.title: Google Local Report Owner Response
items.summary: Google has a new reporting option for reviews in Google Business Profiles and Google Local. This one is called "Report owner response." It lets you tell Google if an owner response to a review is off-topic, contains profanity, is harassing, discriminatory, hateful, or includes personal information.
